voice_separation.report_voice: 月の返事の calm adult polite voice
voice_separation.invariant: A calm polite report must not normalize the recommended draft into the same report voice.

always_prominent.section: おすすめ返信案または送らない判断
送った直後または今夜の代替行動

phases: 判断を見直す観測条件

when_not_selected.omission_condition: No distinct aftercare value beyond the always-prominent actions.

flexible_aftercare_plan.anti_repetition_rule: Do not repeat the same disclaimer, change condition, or action merely to fill a minimum item count.

recommended_draft.rule: Do not create new indecision by presenting several near-duplicate drafts.
recommended_draft.minimal_edit_rule: When the supplied candidate is already good, keep it largely unchanged.
recommended_draft.value_explanation_rule: Explain why preserving the original was the higher-value edit decision.

allowed_adjustments: 敬語を少しやわらげる
明示された範囲で絵文字調整
one_user_initiated_adjustment.execution_boundary: This is a user-initiated revision, not automatic Provider retry, Repair, fallback, or continuation.

user_confirmation_flow: AI does not send to an external service.
The user reads the recommended draft.
The user may manually edit it.
